scanNote:
14-UNITNING BIRINChI BETI (98-bet). Yashil fon.

Yuqorida chapda 'UNIT 14'. Katta qizil qiya 'Live and Let Live'.

O'NGDA POSTER (ko'k): sariq 'The Top 10 Most Wanted', qizil 'ACT NOW!'. Ro'yxat: 1 RHINO 2 GIANT PANDA 3 TIGER 4 GORILLA 5 BLUE WHALE 6 ALLIGATOR SNAPPING TURTLE 7 AFRICAN ELEPHANT 8 WOLF 9 GREEN-CHEEKED PARROT 10 MAKO SHARK. SURATLAR: A - yashil-qizil to'tiqushlar (green-cheeked parrot); B - yo'lbars; C - karkidon (ikki shoxli); D - katta panda; E - akula (mako shark); F - toshbaqa (alligator snapping turtle). Sariq 'wanted ALIVE'.

CHAP USTUN:
• Qizil 'Lead-in'.
1) a) 'Look at the poster and match each animal (A-F) to a name from the list (1-10).' b) 'Which animal:' • has got two horns? [C - namuna] • can copy people's voices? • is a freshwater reptile which breeds once a year? • has got fins and sharp teeth? • has got stripes? • eats bamboo?
2) Kasseta belgisi: a) 'Listen to the sounds and match them to the animals below.' Kataklar: [1] tiger, parrot, horse, whale, polar bear, gorilla, wolf, elephant, chicken. b) 'Which of these animals are not endangered species?'
3) Kasseta belgisi: 'Match the endangered animals to the reasons why they are facing extinction, then listen and check.' TO'Q SARIQ JADVAL 'FACING EXTINCTION': ANIMALS: • rhinos • green-cheeked parrots • alligator snapping turtles. REASONS: • sold as pets, but difficult to breed • killed for their meat • hunted for their horns.

O'NGDA PASTDA:
• Qizil 'Reading'.
4) 'Read what the people say and answer the questions below. Then, explain the words in bold.' 1 Where do rhinos live? 2 What should be done to protect them? 3 Where are green-cheeked parrots found? 4 Why do people value them as pets? 5 How is alligator snapping-turtle meat used? 6 How often do alligator snapping turtles breed?

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '98'.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the poster and match each animal (A-F) to a name from the list (1-10). 1 rhino 2 giant panda 3 tiger 4 gorilla 5 blue whale 6 alligator snapping turtle 7 African elephant 8 wolf 9 green-cheeked parrot 10 mako shark
exercises.instructionUz: Posterga qarang va har bir hayvonni (A-F) ro'yxatdagi nomga (1-10) moslang. 1 karkidon 2 katta panda 3 yo'lbars 4 gorilla 5 ko'k kit 6 alligator toshbaqasi 7 Afrika fili 8 bo'ri 9 yashil yuzli to'tiqush 10 mako akulasi
exercises.explanationUz:
POSTER: 'The Top 10 Most Wanted'
= Eng ko'p qidirilayotgan 10 talik
(ko'chma - eng xavf ostidagi 10 tur).
'wanted ALIVE' = tirik holda
qidirilmoqda (hazil - politsiya
afishalari 'wanted dead or alive').


SURATLAR:
  A - to'tiqushlar → 9 green-
      cheeked parrot
  B - yo'lbars → 3 tiger
  C - karkidon → 1 rhino
  D - panda → 2 giant panda
  E - akula → 10 mako shark
  F - toshbaqa → 6 alligator
      snapping turtle


⚠ 'A RHINO':

  = karkidon. 'rhinoceros' ning
  qisqasi. /ˈraɪnəʊ/.


⚠ 'A SNAPPING TURTLE':

  = tishlovchi toshbaqa.
  ⚠ 'to snap' = tishlamoq (tez).


⚠ 'GREEN-CHEEKED':

  = yashil yuzli.
  ⚠ 'a cheek' = yuz (yonoq).


⚠ 'ACT NOW!':

  = Hozir harakat qiling!

exercises.instructionEn: Which animal: has got two horns? can copy people's voices? is a freshwater reptile which breeds once a year? has got fins and sharp teeth? has got stripes? eats bamboo?
exercises.instructionUz: Qaysi hayvon: ikkita shoxga ega? odamlar ovozini takrorlay oladi? yiliga bir marta ko'payadigan chuchuk suv sudralib yuruvchisi? suzgich va o'tkir tishlarga ega? yo'l-yo'l? bambuk yeydi?
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:
  two horns → C (rhino) - namuna
  copy voices → A (parrot)
  freshwater reptile → F (turtle)
  fins and sharp teeth → E (shark)
  stripes → B (tiger)
  eats bamboo → D (panda)


⚠ 'A HORN':

  = shox.


⚠ 'FRESHWATER':

  = chuchuk suv (daryo, ko'l).
  ⚠ 'saltwater' = sho'r suv.


⚠ 'A REPTILE':

  = sudralib yuruvchi.


⚠ 'TO BREED':

  bred - bred. = ko'paymoq, nasl
  bermoq.


⚠ 'A FIN':

  = suzgich (baliq).


⚠ 'STRIPES':

  = yo'llar (chiziqlar).
  ⚠ 'striped' = yo'l-yo'l.


⚠ 'BAMBOO':

  = bambuk.

exercises.instructionEn: a) Listen to the sounds and match them to the animals below: tiger, parrot, horse, whale, polar bear, gorilla, wolf, elephant, chicken. b) Which of these animals are not endangered species?
exercises.instructionUz: a) Tovushlarni tinglang va ularni quyidagi hayvonlarga moslang: tiger, parrot, horse, whale, polar bear, gorilla, wolf, elephant, chicken. b) Bu hayvonlardan qaysilari xavf ostidagi tur emas?
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ AUDIO KERAK - tovushlar faqat
yozuvdan. 1 = tiger (kitobda).


2b JAVOBI:
  XAVF OSTIDA EMAS: horse (ot),
  chicken (tovuq) - uy hayvonlari.
  ⚠ Qolganlari (tiger, parrot,
  whale, polar bear, gorilla, wolf,
  elephant) - xavf ostida.


⚠ 'ENDANGERED SPECIES':

  = xavf ostidagi turlar (yo'qolib
  ketish xavfi).
  ⚠ 'danger' = xavf.


⚠ 'A POLAR BEAR':

  = oq ayiq.


⚠ 'A WHALE':

  = kit. /weɪl/.

points.en: Animals: tiger, parrot, horse, whale, polar bear, gorilla, wolf, elephant, chicken
points.uz: Hayvonlar: yo'lbars, to'tiqush, ot, kit, oq ayiq, gorilla, bo'ri, fil, tovuq

points.en: b) Not endangered: the horse and the chicken.
points.uz: b) Xavf ostida emas: ot va tovuq.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the endangered animals to the reasons why they are facing extinction, then listen and check.
exercises.instructionUz: Xavf ostidagi hayvonlarni ularning yo'qolib ketish xavfi sabablariga moslang, keyin tinglang va tekshiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:
  rhinos → hunted for their horns
  green-cheeked parrots → sold as
    pets, but difficult to breed
  alligator snapping turtles →
    killed for their meat

  ⚠ 99-betdagi matnlar tasdiqlaydi.


⚠ 'TO FACE EXTINCTION':

  = yo'qolib ketish xavfiga duch
  kelmoq.
  ⚠ 'extinction' = yo'qolib ketish
  (tur).
  ⚠ 'extinct' = yo'qolib ketgan.


⚠ 'TO HUNT FOR':

  = ... uchun ovlamoq.
